name: context-band
description: How full the context window is, as a one-line bar above the prompt, so you know when to /compact or /clear.

warnAtPercent.title: Warm at (% used)
warnAtPercent.description: The bar turns amber once this share of the context window is used.

compactAtPercent.title: Compact at (% used)
compactAtPercent.description: The bar turns red and suggests /compact once this share of the context window is used.
